abstract_sentences.text: Video anomaly detection (VAD) systems often prioritize accuracy while overlooking privacy concerns, limiting their suitability for real-world deployment.

evidence.anchor: VAD systems often prioritize accuracy

abstract_sentences.text: We propose the Orthogonal Projection Layer (OPL), a lightweight module that removes task-irrelevant variations to produce representations focused on anomaly-relevant cues.

evidence.anchor: We propose the Orthogonal Projection Layer

abstract_sentences.text: To address privacy risks in human-centered scenarios, we introduce Guided OPL (G-OPL), which suppresses facial attributes using weak supervision from face-presence signals while preserving non-identifying features such as pose and motion.
abstract_sentences.comparison: facial attributes versus pose and motion

evidence.anchor: G-OPL suppresses facial attributes

abstract_sentences.text: A cosine alignment objective enforces consistent capture and removal of facial information without identity labels or adversarial training.

evidence.anchor: cosine alignment objective

abstract_sentences.text: We further present a privacy-aware evaluation framework that jointly assesses detection performance and privacy preservation, and enables analysis of how sensitive information is filtered.

evidence.anchor: privacy-aware evaluation framework

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments show that embedding privacy constraints into model design reduces sensitive information while maintaining or improving detection accuracy, supporting projection-based architectures as a principled approach for privacy-aware VAD.
abstract_sentences.relation: closes with the broad impact claim

final_judgment.single_storyline: VAD 的 accuracy-first representation leakage 被重写为 feature-space subspace filtering problem；OPL 学 nuisance complement，G-OPL 用 weak face signal 对齐 sensitive residual，再用 privacy/utility probes 选择 rank 与 layer（p. 3–9，§3–4；interpretation）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq. (1)–(9)、OPL/G-OPL loss、SSC/ARD/PD/FPD、五数据集 setup、主 utility/privacy 表、placement 图和 efficiency 表，足以重建最短决策链（p. 3–9；explicit）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A–M 承担 separability theory、伪代码、device flow、配置网格、VISPR/CHAD/blurred-face 扩展和 failure analysis；正文简洁但 generality、threat scope 与复现边界依赖附录（p. 14–32；interpretation）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 把模块、loss 和 data flow 放在同一图中，Figure 5/6 将 feature separation 与 Q Q^T 变成可视证据，Tables 4–6 并列 utility、privacy 和 cost（p. 2、7–9；layout_observation）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: nuisance semantics、identity removal 与 edge privacy guarantee 主要由 linear probes、ArcFace 和 UMAP 代理；缺少 adaptive nonlinear attacker、formal privacy bound、seed uncertainty 与 causal intervention（p. 3–5、8、17–18、20；interpretation）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: representation filtering 主张应在正文同时给出 removal target、攻击者 probe、任务效用、重复运行/误差和 threat boundary，并让每个组件对应至少一个机制检验（p. 4–9；interpretation）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合 privacy、fairness、disentanglement 与 representation filtering；proxy probe 不能等价于所有攻击者，也不能替代真实敏感语义的干预或 formal privacy definition（p. 14–18、22；explicit and interpretation）。
